freeze_stage: semantic definitions before policy implementation, fixtures/tests before inference
decoder: unchanged original RLCD selector; language bridge is separately declared local generation experiment
live_first_attempts: four cases under chosen declared policy/model; retain all blocked/unrun cases; any extra model-policy cells are a declared comparison, not replacement
language_scoring: strict semantics separately from JSON/schema validity, interpretation separately from human corrected/reviewed execution; ambiguity/missing/conflict require no authorized action
offline_comparison: paired same recorded observation, task, candidate semantics and order where applicable; do not infer gold from comparator outputs; exposed user runs are regression only

gates.coverage: never claim settings/excel support from abstention or absent candidates
gates.completion: four requested live cases count; unsupported/unrun not pass
gates.pagination: verify actual target off first detail page before claiming live pagination

no_claims: unassisted natural-language autonomy from guided completion
two browser pages equal two native apps
saved bytes alone prove explicit save
source tests prove a live branch executed
